# Media test fixture

`still-tiny.heic` is a genuine 320 × 427 HEIC still-image fixture from the
[HEIC.Best sample corpus](https://heic.best/heic-samples). It is 95,592 bytes
and has SHA-256
`55af20f9ecd8a110cc6c028c1765bbb451b0aec722578ea89a75a15f7c1b6428`.

The corpus identifies this file and its public-domain source stills as CC0 1.0.
The corpus license is included in [LICENSE-CC0.txt](./LICENSE-CC0.txt).
